text: This report is filed regarding the account of Rabia Qadir (CNIC 491151-5555986-5), a student with a declared monthly income of PKR 25,000, whose activity between August 1 and August 10, 2026, exhibits classic money mule characteristics. The account received 27 distinct inbound transfers totaling approximately PKR 1,150,000 from numerous unrelated individuals across multiple banks (Synthetic Bank A, B, and C). This volume is grossly disproportionate to the customer's profile and declared income. The funds were not retained but rapidly swept out via three large outgoing transfers to a single QuickPay wallet (ending in 0932) and two high-value ATM withdrawals at the Blue Area branch in Islamabad. Specifically, PKR 234,000 was transferred to the wallet on August 4, followed by a PKR 240,000 ATM withdrawal the same day. On August 7, PKR 182,000 was sent to the wallet, and on August 9, another PKR 226,000 was withdrawn in cash. Finally, on August 10, a further PKR 297,000 was transferred to the wallet. The pattern of rapid layering, the use of a single e-wallet as a consolidation point, and the high-frequency cash withdrawals suggest the account is being used to launder illicit funds. The customer has not been contacted regarding this review, and the outgoing wallet transfers are currently on hold.
